PLAN "12-Week Upper Body Programme — Post-Impingement Return for Recreational Climber"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild pain-free pulling and pressing strength for climbing"
  GOAL secondary mobility:
    name "Restore scapular control and shoulder stability"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Maintain general conditioning during rehab"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Scapular Control and Tissue Tolerance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Scapular Foundations A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          scapular_retraction 2x12
          arm_circles 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          prone_Y 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          prone_T 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 2x10
          hip_circles 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Scapular Foundations B":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          scapular_retraction 2x12
          prone_W 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          inverted_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
